## Summary

**Main tweet — the pitch:** "tadalafil costs me $0.08c per week. i should be paying more for all these health benefits:" — his 13-item list: improves blood vessel health; linked to lower all-cause mortality; anti-inflammatory effects (daily use); associated with fewer heart attacks; spontaneous erections with daily use; prevents cognitive decline in older adults; shown to boost lean muscle mass; associated with lower stroke risk; helps blood flow at high altitude; possible lower dementia risk; increases cerebral flow; fewer night urinations; relieves BPH/LUTS. Ends "not medical advice."

**Quoted tweet — the study claim:** "tadalafil is a cognitive enhancer." 5mg daily for 8 weeks in men with erectile dysfunction AND mild cognitive impairment: thinking score (MoCA) 18.9 → 21.8; erectile function score 7.5 → 12.9; blood flow increased in the postcentral gyrus, precuneus and brainstem. "not medical advise."

**Study identified from the tweet's own screenshot (OCR):** Jin Bong Choi et al., "The Effect of Daily Low Dose Tadalafil on Cerebral Perfusion and Cognition in Patients with Erectile Dysfunction and Mild Cognitive Impairment", *Clin Psychopharmacol Neurosci*, 2019 — a small Korean open-label study in a comorbid ED+MCI population.

## Why it matters

Third leg of this week's cognition thread, and a different mechanism from the other two: where [[2026-11-10-limitlesstack-modafinil-thesis]] is stimulant wakefulness and [[2026-11-10-zygomatic03-pinealon-social-fluidity]] is peptide bioregulation, this one is the **vascular angle** — PDE5 inhibition → nitric oxide / blood-flow improvements claimed to compound into longevity and cognition benefits. That "cheap generic repurposed drug as daily longevity tool" framing is the pattern to recognize here.

Skepticism gates: the 13-item list is carefully weasel-worded by the author himself ("linked to", "associated with", "possible") — association-level evidence for most items, not established effects of daily tadalafil in healthy people. The one concrete study (Choi 2019) is small, open-label, in ED+MCI patients (MoCA 18.9 baseline = impaired cohort) — not evidence a healthy young adult gains cognition. "$0.08/week" implies gray-market generic bulk powder sourcing; tadalafil is prescription-only, genuinely contraindicated with nitrates (hypotension), and has dosing side effects (headache, back pain). Same UAE posture as the thread's other notes: prescription-controlled, gray-market shipping risk. Reference-only, no task — RD's stance on this thread is checking, not ordering (2026-11-10T18:11Z).
